name: What is international marketing for luxury real estate?

mainEntity.name: What is international marketing for luxury real estate?

acceptedAnswer.text: International marketing for luxury real estate involves strategically promoting high-value properties to potential buyers outside the local market. This includes leveraging global advertising platforms, targeted digital campaigns, and a network of international agents to reach a wider, affluent audience. For properties in areas like Miami-Dade and Broward County, this approach is crucial due to the significant international interest in South Florida real estate, helping to maximize exposure and attract diverse buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: International marketing promotes luxury properties to buyers outside the local market using global platforms and networks.
